questions.stem: A 22-Year-old primigravida with 38 weeks of gestation presents with pain abdomen, backache, contractions, and show. She is a case of mitral stenosis due to RHD and is on treatment. Abdominal examination shows fundus just below xiphisternum, vertical lie, cephalic presentation, head engaged, FHR-140/min, contractions of 3/10mins. PV examination shows cervix soft, dilated 3cm, 2cm long, head at station 0, membranes intact. NST was normal. Consider the following statements about the prognosis of such cases. The true statement is /are:1. Maternal mortality is low in Rheumatic heart disease and a cyanotic heart disease2. Most deaths occur due to cardiac failure3. Maximum deaths occur following birth4.
